sentences.text:
This application for bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner who has been arrested in connection with FIR No.212/2023 registered at Police Station Kudi Bhagtasani,
District Jodhpur City (West), for offences under Sections 376(2) (N), 384 and 506 IPC, 67 of Information Technology Act.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner has been falsely implicated in the present case.

Learned counsel submitted that the prosecutrix, who is a mature married woman has lodged the FIR after about five years from the date on which the alleged incident of sexual assault was committed upon the prosecutrix.

Learned counsel submitted that the FIR has been [2023:RJ-JD:36119] (2 of 3) [CRLMB-12824/2023] filed without furnishing any plausible explanation for such an extraordinary delay in reporting of the offences.

Learned counsel submitted that as per prosecutrix, she was made to consume a drink containing intoxicant substance and Prem Prakash vs State Of Rajasthan (2023:Rj-Jd:36119) on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/56769082/
1 thereupon, her obscene videos and photographs were snapped by the petitioner to blackmail her.

entities.text: Prem Prakash vs State Of Rajasthan (2023:Rj-Jd:36119)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It was urged that no obscene videos or photographs of the prosecutrix have been recovered.

Drawing attention of the Court towards various photographs in which the petitioner and prosecutrix can be seen in jovial mood, learned counsel submitted that the petitioner and the prosecutrix were in consensual relationship.
However, owing to some property dispute and on their relations turning strained, the petitioner has been roped in a false criminal case.

Lastly, learned counsel submitted that the petitioner is in judicial custody, no recovery is due to be made from the petitioner and the trial of the case will take sufficiently long time, therefore, the benefit of bail should be granted to the accused-petitioner.
Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor and learned counsel for the complainant have vehemently opposed the bail application.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Public Prosecutor and learned counsel for the complainant.
Perused the material available on record.

Having considered the rival submissions, facts and circumstances of the case and the case file produced before this Court by the learned Public Prosecutor, this Court does not find plausible explanation on the part of the prosecutrix in lodging the FIR after a delay of five years from the date of alleged incident of [2023:RJ-JD:36119] (3 of 3) [CRLMB-12824/2023] sexual assault.

Having gone through the case file, in the prima facie opinion of this Court, the argument advanced by learned counsel for the petitioner that the prosecutrix willingly stayed in relationship with the petitioner and either the relationship between them did not stand or some property dispute as alleged by the petitioner cropped up between the parties, the present FIR has been lodged by the prosecutrix against the petitioner, cannot be brushed aside at this stage.
Thus, without expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case, this Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

Accordingly, the bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is ordered that the accused-petitioner- Prem Prakash S/o Shri Tulsiram shall be enlarged on bail in connection with FIR No.212/2023 registered at Police Station Kudi Bhagtasani, District Jodhpur City (West),
provided he furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties of Rs.25,000/-
each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Judge for his appearance before the court concerned on all the dates of hearing as and when called upon to so.
It is however, made clear that findings recorded/observations made above are for limited purposes of adjudication of bail application.
The trial court shall not get prejudiced by the same.
(KULDEEP MATHUR),J /tarun goyal/ Sr.No.130 Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)
